title: loadng: with_incremented_hop_count overflow is silent
description: The hop_count increment uses saturating_add which silently caps at 255. Inconsistent with with_decremented_hop_limit() which returns Option to signal boundary. Callers cannot detect metric saturation.
close_reason: Fixed: changed with_incremented_hop_count to return Option<Self>, returning None at u8::MAX to signal saturation (consistent with with_decremented_hop_limit). Added 3 tests.
